title: Craig Brackins
wikitext:
'''Craig Brackins''' (born October 9, 1987 in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[basketball]] player who most recently played for the [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State Cyclones]].<ref>[http://www.cyclones.com/ViewArticle.dbml?SPSID=46664&SPID=4252&DB_OEM_ID=10700&ATCLID=883494&Q_SEASON=2007 Player Biography] at Cyclones.com</ref> A [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]], Brackins was the highest-touted recruit to choose Iowa State after spending time at [[Brewster Academy]] in [[New Hampshire]]. In March 2009, Brackins was predicted to be a first round draft pick in the [[2009 NBA Draft]] should he declare. On April 24, 2009, Craig Brackins announced that he would return to Iowa State for his junior season, instead of declaring for the NBA Draft.<ref>http://www.cyclones.com/SportSelect.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=10700&KEY=&SPID=4252&SPSID=46661</ref>
==College career==
===2008–09 season===

Brackins rose to national prominence following a game in January 2009 against [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]] in which he scored 42 points and grabbed 14 rebounds, despite Iowa State losing 82–67 to the Jayhawks.<ref>[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/columns/story?columnist=katz_andy&id=4296457 Brackins spurns NBA's advances] ESPN.com, June 30, 2009</ref>

===2009–10 season===
Brackins scored 28 points and grabbed 12 rebounds in a 96–55 blowout of [[Mississippi Valley State University|Mississippi Valley State]] on November 22, 2009.  Brackins declared himself eligible for the 2010 NBA Draft on March 12, 2010<ref>[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=293260066 Mississippi Valley State Delta Devils vs. Iowa State Cyclones - Recap - November 22, 2009 - ESPN]</ref>
